The established build-capable Review root is `Review Gecko root` (not `comm` alone). Source worktrees are cheap; independent compiled object directories are not. Use immutable artifact snapshots, APFS clone/copy-on-write, bounded retention/cleanup, storage quotas, and preflight free-space checks. [Task 2]
